Returns, the simple version

Every piece is handmade to order — here’s how we handle it if something isn’t right.

  • Made to order. Most pieces take 5–7 days to make before they ship.
  • Personalized pieces are final sale, unless they arrive damaged or different from what you ordered.
  • Non-personalized pieces can be returned within 7 days of delivery — you cover the return shipping.
  • Damaged or wrong? Email a photo to support@deenbay.com and the seller will replace it or refund you.

Each founding seller confirms their policy with us before their products go live.
